recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile portrait browser survival game called **Elm Street Never Sleep**. Preserve the source mechanics: canvas arena, virtual joystick movement, GRAB nearby item, STRIKE in a directional arc, pursuing enemies, three health pips, score per defeated enemy, collectible index persistence, start/game-over/restart states. Reinterpret the world as an Elm Street dream-horror chase: the player is a half-awake teen dreamer, pickups are bedside talismans, enemies are clawed sweater-striped nightmare shades, score is panic, health is wakefulness, and the playfield is a procedural shifting suburb/boiler-room nightmare. Use touch-friendly controls, high-contrast HUD, portrait-first layout, and procedural CSS/canvas art rather than stock assets.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
- genre: mobile-first top-down canvas survival/evasion combat arena
- objective: survive as long as possible, collect tools/talismans, defeat pursuers for score
- input model: touch joystick plus GRAB and STRIKE buttons, with keyboard fallback
- core loop: start run, move through a large world, pick up nearby items, strike nearby enemies in a forward arc, avoid contact damage, collect score and journal entries
- fail/friction state: three health pips; contact damage with invulnerability; game over at zero health; restart/menu flows

## Protected mechanics
- requestAnimationFrame update/render loop, world size, camera follow, movement speed/friction, enemy pursuit, collision damage, strike cone, pickup radius, weapon stats, spawn caps/timers, score on kill, three-health fail state, persistent collection index, and mobile control semantics.

## Remix target
Nightmare on Elm Street dream-horror with Freddy Krueger nightmare logic, surreal traps, sleep deprivation panic, dark comedy menace, reality-bending supernatural dread, and mobile-first portrait controls.

## Regeneration approach
The survivor becomes a half-awake Elm Street dreamer, weapons become bedside talismans, enemies become clawed nightmare shades, score becomes PANIC, health becomes WAKEFULNESS, the collection screen becomes a Dream Journal, and the suburb becomes a shifting boiler-room/bedroom nightmare rendered procedurally in canvas and CSS.
